ruleDefinitions.name: Credential Dumping Tools Service Execution - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects well-known credential dumping tools execution via service execution events Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*cachedump.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*dumpsvc.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*fgexec.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*gsecdump.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*mimidrv.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*pwdump.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*servpw.*")))
